note: v6 lane B part 2, the intro tutorial (src/tutorial.js; tools/tutorial-notes.md). Eight practice forts played on the real engine and board, then a closing card. Never in levels 1-200, teaching.json or the save's progress. A step: id, name (the top bar), board (a level record: pic board, pal, cols, win, optional jam, hidden, shade), coach (the coach band's lines in order; card/line/power/mystery/ring pointers as config.teach, slot: the space a picked power-up can take; go: when the line moves on, any of '|', all of '&', a leading '!' negates: play, used:m, wait, lineEmpty, full, reveal, shown, pick:k, power:k, canRecall, clear:m, won, jammed; skip: same words, the line is passed by when it no longer fits the board), coach2 (the lines after a jam's Retry), done (when the step is done, same words), say (the done card), jamNote (under the jam's real fail words), final (the real win sheet ends it), powers (the practice stock: power ids with one use each; none: no badges).

offer.title: New here?
offer.say: Learn in a couple of minutes on a tiny practice fort. Nothing to lose.
offer.foot: It's in Settings > How to play any time.

ui.winLine: The goblin king flees. Practice fort cleared.

campaign.name: Campaign
campaign.say: 200 forts that get hard, with the Goblin King at the top.

zen.name: Zen
zen.say: Pictures to dig out at your own pace.

steps.name: Send a squad

coach.say: Tap a squad to send its sappers in.
The number is how many sappers go.

steps.say: Each card is a squad: one colour and how many sappers are in it. Only the front card of a column can go.

steps.name: Nearest first

coach.say: Tap blue and watch where they dig.
They take the nearest blue they can reach.

steps.say: Sappers always dig the nearest block of their colour that they can reach, one block each.

steps.name: The holding line

coach.say: Tap yellow. Only {reach} yellow blocks are in reach.
The rest wait in a space. Now tap red.
Red opens the wall and the waiting sappers go.

steps.say: A squad only sends sappers it has blocks for. The rest wait in a space on the line and go by themselves once more blocks open.

steps.name: Don't jam

coach.say: Tap blue until all 5 spaces are full.
Blue can't reach a single block.

coach2.say: Tap blue to bring red to the front.
Now red. It opens the wall for blue.

steps.jamNote: That's a jam. Tap Retry and open the wall first.
steps.say: If every space holds a squad that can't reach a block, the line jams and you start over. Open the way first.

steps.name: Hidden things

coach.say: Tap red. Watch the ? squad behind it.
It turned over. Now tap red again to dig in.
A ? block shows once a path reaches it.

steps.say: A ? squad turns face up when it reaches the front of its column. A ? block shows its colour once a dug-out path from the camp reaches it.

steps.name: Shades

coach.say: Light, mid or dark, it's all orange. Tap orange.
One orange squad digs every shade.

steps.say: Shades are just looks. A lighter or darker block still belongs to its colour, so one squad of that colour digs them all.

steps.name: Power-ups

coach.say: Tap yellow. It's walled in, so it waits.
Practice Recall: tap it, then the waiting squad.
Now tap the waiting squad.
Practice Ladder: one more space, this fort only.
Green opens the wall. Then yellow.
Now clear the yellow.

steps.say: Ladder adds a space and Recall sends a waiting squad back. In the game you earn them, plus three more:
more: Quartermaster sends any squad you can see straight out.
Scout turns every ? squad face up.
Volley clears one colour off the fort.

coach.say: Clear every block to win. Start with what's in reach.
